command:
set -eu
mkdir -p /workspace/tools /workspace/jobs/go-probe; cd /workspace/tools
VER=$(curl -s -m 20 'https://go.dev/VERSION?m=text' | head -1); echo "latest go: $VER"
if [ ! -x /workspace/tools/go/bin/go ]; then nice -n 19 curl -fsSL -m 120 -o go.tgz https://go.dev/dl/$VER.linux-amd64.tar.gz; sha256sum go.tgz; nice -n 19 tar -C /workspace/tools -xzf go.tgz; rm -f go.tgz; fi
export PATH=/workspace/tools/go/bin:$PATH GOPATH=/workspace/tools/gopath GOCACHE=/workspace/tools/gocache GOFLAGS=-mod=mod
go version
cd /workspace/jobs/go-probe; rm -rf m; mkdir m; cd m
cat > go.mod <<'M'
module probe
go 1.21
M
cat > a.go <<'M'
package main
import "fmt"
func Add(a,b int) int { return a+b }
func main(){ fmt.Println(Add(2,3)) }
M
cat > a_test.go <<'M'
package main
import "testing"
func TestAdd(t *testing.T){ if Add(2,3)!=5 { t.Fatal("bad") } }
M
/usr/bin/time -v nice -n 19 timeout 120 go build ./... 2>&1 | egrep "Elapsed|Maximum resident" || true
/usr/bin/time -v nice -n 19 timeout 120 go test ./... 2>&1 | egrep "ok|FAIL|Elapsed|Maximum resident" || true
echo "== stdlib test sample (small pkg)"; nice -n 19 timeout 120 go test strings 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "== omega repo clone w/o creds"; GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 timeout 30 git ls-remote https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/oMEGAcV1.git HEAD 2>&1 | head -2 || true
echo "== entity repo local clone & go files"; ls /workspace/clay-global-research-entity | head -3; find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -name go.mod -not -path "*/tools/*" 2>/dev/null | head -5
df -h /workspace | tail -1; du -sh /workspace/tools | tail -1
